# Task: Create Standard Project Structure

Create a standard project structure with the following folders:
- /workspace/src
- /workspace/tests
- /workspace/docs
- /workspace/config

All folders should be created as empty directories.

To create the standard project structure with the specified folders, you can use the following commands in your terminal:

```bash
mkdir -p workspace/src
mkdir -p workspace/tests
mkdir -p workspace/docs
mkdir -p workspace/config
```

This will create the following directory structure:

```
workspace/
├── config/
├── docs/
├── src/
└── tests/
```

All folders will be created as empty directories.
